# Leyline (`leyline-http`)

> Async HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 client for Rust on Tokio with sessions, crawling, resumable downloads, DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and TLS 1.3 ECH, proxies, and optional browser TLS profiles. Package: `leyline-http`. Library import: `leyline`. MSRV: Rust 1.96.

## Core types

- `Session`: owns the connection pool, cookie jar, cache, TLS context, and settings. Build once and clone across tasks. Plain client: `Session::new()`. Browser profile: `Session::from(Browser::default())` or `Session::builder().browser(Browser::Chrome158).build()?`.
- `Tab`: browser-tab navigation (`open`, `follow`, `submit`, `submit_form` are `async fn -> Result<Response>` directly; `fetch(method, url)` returns `RequestBuilder`; `page(impl Into<Option<Url>>)` sets the current URL).
- `RequestBuilder`: per-request headers, body, timeouts, retry/redirect/proxy/protocol overrides, `.stream()`, `.pages()`, `.events()`, `.download_to(path)`, `.websocket()`, `.build()`, `.try_clone()`.
- `Response`: status, headers, `relay_headers`, `text`, `json`, `bytes`, `bytes_stream`, `read_until`, `download_to`, `into_http`, `from_cache`, `remote_addr`, `ech_accepted`, `block`, `links`, timing, and audit headers/fingerprints.
- `Error`: match on `err.kind()` (`Kind`, 19 variants, `#[non_exhaustive]`) or predicates (`is_connect`, `is_proxy`, `is_retryable`, `is_timeout`, `is_shut_down`, `is_profile_changed`). Construct custom hook errors with `Error::request(cause)`.

## Module layout

- Crate root `leyline`: `Session`, `SessionBuilder`, `Tab`, `RequestBuilder`, `Response`, `Body`, `Error`, `Kind`, `Result`, `IntoUrl`, `Browser`, `Platform`, `Protocol`, `Proxy`, `Redirect`, `Retry`, `Timeout`, `Attempt`, `Block`, `HostLimits`, `Link`, `Stats`, `Tls`, `TlsVersion`, `Resolver`, `WebSocket`, `Message`, `Bytes`, `Url`, `http`, `get`, `redact_url`.
- `leyline::blocking`: `Session` (`SessionBuilder::build_blocking()`) for synchronous callers outside Tokio.
- `leyline::cookie`: `Jar`, `Cookie`, `CookieBuilder`, `SameSite`.
- `leyline::crawl`: `Robots`, `RobotsSource`, `Purpose`; with default feature `html`: `Crawl`, `Page`, `Respect`, `Scope`, `SkipReason`.
- `leyline::html` (default feature `html`): `Form`, `Anchor`, `Directives`, `forms`, `links`, `meta`, `canonical`, `text`. `html::Form` is a different type from `multipart::Form`.
- `leyline::multipart` (default feature `multipart`): `Form`, `Part`.
- `leyline::profile`: `RequestKind`, `HeaderPosition`, `Encoding`, `TcpProfile`, `Fingerprint`.
- `leyline::sse`: `Events`, `Event`.
- `leyline::trace`: `Trace`, `Event`, `Log`, `Metrics`.
- `leyline::testing` (feature `test-util`, add under `[dev-dependencies]`): `Server`, `Request`, `Response`, `queue`.

## Rules that prevent mistakes

- Pin browser variants for stability: use `Browser::Chrome158` when fingerprints must not drift across releases. `Browser::default()` moves to the newest Chrome.
- Status codes: `4xx`/`5xx` responses are `Ok` until `.error_for_status()` is called (`Kind::Status`). `err.retries_exhausted()` is set only on these `Kind::Status` errors from `RequestBuilder::error_for_status()`.
- JSON errors are `Kind::Json`, not `Kind::Decode`. `serde_json::Error` does not convert into `leyline::Error` through `?`; wrap it with `Error::request(...)` inside hooks.
- Retries: with no retry policy set, nothing retries. `retry(n)` allows `n` more attempts on idempotent methods. With a policy set, a request that never reached the server retries whatever its method. Crawl page fetches default to 2 retries.
- Pagination needs `futures-util`: `RequestBuilder::pages()` returns an opaque `Stream` with no inherent `.next()`. Add `futures-util` to `Cargo.toml` and `use futures_util::StreamExt;`. `Body::next`, `Events::next`, and `Crawl::next` are inherent async methods and need no trait import.
- Timeouts on streams and long downloads: `timeout(Duration)` sets `Timeout::total` (300 s default). It stops at the response headers for `.stream()` requests and spans retries on `RequestBuilder::download_to`. For long downloads, set `Timeout::new().total(None).read(...).body(...)` and `max_body_size(None)`. The default cap is 100 MiB on buffered and `.stream()` responses; the setter takes `impl Into<Option<usize>>`.
- Streamed bodies: an HTTP/1.1 streamed response body buffers up to 32 chunks before the transport waits for the reader.
- Download-only options: `RequestBuilder::download_to(path)` rejects `4xx`/`5xx` and supports `.retry(n)`, `.sha256([u8; 32])`, and `.progress(impl Fn(u64, Option<u64>) + Send + Sync + 'static)` (not `FnMut`). `sha256`, `progress`, and `resume` fail with `Kind::Config` on `send()`/`text()`/`bytes()`/`pages()`/`events()`/`websocket()`.
- Setter types: `HostLimits::max_total_pending(usize)` does not take `None`; `max_pending` does. `SessionBuilder::interface(impl Into<String>)` does not take `None`. `Tls::{ca_pem, client_cert_pkcs12, ech_config_list}` take `impl Into<Vec<u8>>`, so `Vec<u8>` and `Bytes` both work.
- TCP: `TCP_NODELAY` is already on through the platform TCP profile on Windows, macOS, Linux, and iOS. Do not set `tcp_nodelay` to avoid Nagle delays. The getter is `TcpProfile::no_delay()`, with an underscore.
- Tracing: the `Event::Done` field is `outcome` (not `error`), and every `Event` variant is `#[non_exhaustive]`. `Metrics::status_class(u8)` takes `u8`.
- Async vs sync: `Crawl::save(&mut self, path).await` is async. `Crawl::load(&session, path)` and `testing::Server::{http_on, https_on}` are sync. `Server::{requests, next_request, shutdown}` are async.
- Hooks and auth: `before_send` sees the request's own headers, including a request-level `bearer_auth`. It does not see the session's `bearer_auth`/`basic_auth`, session default headers, or cookies. It does not re-run on redirects or on 401 `refresh_token`/Digest resends. `refresh_token` requires both `base_url` and `bearer_auth`. A session `user_agent` or a request `user-agent` header drops browser `sec-ch-ua*` client hints.
- Saving: `serde_json::to_string(&session)` and `Session::save` write the same data: identity, cookie jar, proxy without its password, TLS session tickets, `Alt-Svc`, and HSTS. `build()` on a restored builder fails with `is_profile_changed()` when the bundled profile changed.
- Proxies, TLS, and DoH: `Proxy` scheme rules (`http`/`https`) beat `all` regardless of call order. `no_proxy` is port-aware (`host:port`, `[::1]:8080`). `Session::save` does not persist `Proxy::list`/`Proxy::identified`/`Proxy::custom` or `Proxy::identified`'s per-proxy cookie jars. `Proxy::identified` requires a browser session. `Tls` pins or client certs fail requests over `https://` proxies with `Kind::Proxy`. `SessionBuilder::doh` inherits the session's `Tls` minus client certificates, pins, and ECH settings, so disabling `system_roots` with an internal CA breaks public DoH unless the DoH root is also trusted.
- Gateways and Tower: shared `Session`s have cookies and redirects on by default. Set `.cookies(None).redirect(Redirect::none())` for multi-tenant gateways. Calling `tower::Service` requires `features = ["tower"]`, `tower-service = "0.3"`, and `use tower_service::Service;`. `Session::call` leaves hop-by-hop headers intact, and `leyline::Body` implements `futures_util::Stream` (not `http_body::Body`). Gateways should use `session.request_from(req).stream().send().await?`, `resp.relay_headers()`, `resp.into_http()?`, and wrap the body (for example `axum::body::Body::from_stream`).

## Guide pages

- [Introduction](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/index.html): Plain vs browser sessions, `Session`/`Tab`/`Crawl` mental model, and guide map.
- [Quick start](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/quick-start.html): Dependency setup, GET/POST, JSON, status errors, downloads.
- [API clients](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/api-clients.html): `base_url`, `bearer_auth`, rate-limit retries, `pages()`, HTTP cache, `refresh_token`.
- [Sessions](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/sessions.html): Auth scoping, `before_send`, `cookies(None)`, `build_blocking`, `to_builder`, `shutdown`, `save`/`load`.
- [Requests](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/requests.html): Methods, headers, `Body::file`, multipart, `RequestKind`, `Tab`, `protocol`, `build`/`request_from`/`execute`.
- [Responses](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/responses.html): Status, headers, `relay_headers`, `Link` pagination, body caps, `from_cache`, `ech_accepted`, `into_http`.
- [Errors](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/errors.html): Complete 19-variant `Kind` table, `gateway_status()`, 6 predicates, `Error::request`, `Error::find`.
- [Retries and timeouts](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/retries-and-timeouts.html): `Retry` policies, `budget`, `wait_header`, idempotency, and all 6 `Timeout` fields.
- [Streaming](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/streaming.html): Resumable `download_to`, `Body::stream`, `bytes_stream`, `StreamReader`, `read_until`, SSE (`leyline::sse`).
- [Cancellation](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/cancellation.html): Cancelling requests with timeouts or `tokio::select!`, and wire behavior on drop.
- [Redirects](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/redirects.html): `Redirect` limits, credential/body-header stripping, custom policies.
- [Proxies](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/proxies.html): HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxies, custom headers, port-aware `no_proxy`, env discovery, `Proxy::list`, `Proxy::identified`, `Proxy::custom`.
- [Choosing a profile](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/choosing-a-profile.html): Browser families, platforms, stability, JA4 labels.
- [Cookies](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/cookies.html): `Jar`, `Cookie::parse`, `CookieBuilder`, `cookies(None)`, persistence.
- [Accounts](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/accounts.html): `Tab` sessions, HTML form login, `Session::save`/`load`, `autosave`, TLS/HSTS/Alt-Svc state.
- [Crawling](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/crawling.html): `Session::crawl`, `robots.txt`, `HostLimits`, `Block`, `SkipReason`, checkpoints.
- [WebSocket](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/websocket.html): HTTP/2 extended `CONNECT` and HTTP/1.1 upgrades, `version`/`headers`/`header`, tuning.
- [HTTP/3](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/http3.html): `http3` feature, `Protocol::Race` vs `Auto`, per-request `.protocol(...)`.
- [TLS trust](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/tls-trust.html): `Tls` setters (`ca_file`, `ca_der`, `ca_pem`, pins, PEM/PKCS#12 mTLS, ECH, `min_version`).
- [Network](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/network.html): DNS overrides, DoH, Happy Eyeballs, `unix_socket`, `interface`, `TcpProfile`, pool tuning, `HostLimits`, HSTS.
- [Logging and tracing](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/logging.html): `tracing` targets, `trace::Log`, `trace::Metrics`, `Trace::event`.
- [Service integration](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/service-integration.html): Axum/hyper gateways, `tower::Service` (`tower-service = "0.3"`), `http` interop, shared sessions, gateway status mapping.
- [Throughput](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/throughput.html): Default async vs `run_per_core` vs `build_blocking`, Tokio tuning, allocators.
- [Testing](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/testing.html): `testing::Server` (`http`, `https`, `http_on`, `https_on`), `queue`, wire assertions.
- [Fingerprints](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/fingerprints.html): TLS, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, `TcpProfile::from_ja4t`, live session auditing (`akamai()`).
- [Cargo features and linking](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/features-and-targets.html): Default and optional features, minimal builds, dependency implications.
- [Supported platforms](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/platforms.html): Targets, Docker/CI prerequisites, `LEYLINE_BSSL_*` env vars.
- [Profile reference](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/profiles.html): Bundled profiles, stability, custom TOML profiles.
- [MSRV](https://manaforged.github.io/leyline-http/guide/msrv.html): Rust 1.96 MSRV and edition policy.
- [API reference (docs.rs)](https://docs.rs/leyline-http): Full rustdoc for every public item.
- [Repository AGENTS.md](https://github.com/manaforged/leyline-http/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Concise coding-agent cheat sheet.
